title: Capture production TLS guide screenshots
description:
Problem: the production TLS runbook includes screenshot placeholders but lacks deployment evidence images.

Desired outcome: collect operational screenshots for hosted HTTPS deployment workflows and embed them into `ops/https-production-tls`.

Scope:
- In scope: capture images for `HTTPS-PROD-01` through `HTTPS-PROD-08`, scrub environment-sensitive values, and insert markdown image references.
- Out of scope: changing production architecture recommendations.

Acceptance criteria:
- Every production TLS placeholder ID has a corresponding image and inline placement in the runbook.
- Captures include IIS/reverse-proxy or Kestrel evidence appropriate to the deployment path in use.
- Any hostnames/secrets not intended for publication are redacted.

Validation:
- Render `ops/https-production-tls` in `/pages` and confirm all image links resolve and support operator walkthrough.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track production TLS screenshot capture and runbook image insertion.
